I couldn't confirm that the DOI for this exact title is 10.1515/lity.2008.007. The only matching record I found is [10.1515/THLI.2008.007](https://degruyterbrill.com/document/doi/10.1515/THLI.2008.007/pdf), a Croft & Poole article in *Theoretical Linguistics*, and its title doesn't match. Check the title on doi.org before citing the `lity` DOI from the team note.
